verdict.rationale: Honcho ships an official MCP server, hosted at mcp.honcho.dev or run locally, which gives any MCP-compatible AI tool persistent memory. It also offers a dedicated Claude Code plugin, and its docs state that Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and custom agents all read the same understanding of the user, so the core cross-tool shared-memory story is documented first-party. missing for 10: explicit evidence for connecting ChatGPT specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration that multiple tools actually share one memory in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect off-the-shelf assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the same memory so every tool I use shares what it knows about me

citations.quote: The Honcho MCP server gives any MCP-compatible AI tool persistent memory and personalization.
every AI tool you use — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, your own agent — reads the same understanding of who you are. Switch tools without starting over.
Claude Code Honcho plugin for a deeper integration with persistent memory, git awareness, and agent skills
Reads and writes ~/.honcho/config.json — the same file plugins, host integrations, and SDKs use.
